must_cover: plants need light, water and carbon dioxide
plants make their own food in their leaves
oxygen is released when plants make food

lessons.title: What plants need
lessons.objective: Identify light, water and carbon dioxide as the things a plant takes in to make food.
must_establish: light, water and carbon dioxide are the three things taken in

lessons.title: Where food is made
lessons.objective: Explain that leaves are the main place where a plant makes its food.
must_establish: the leaf is the site of food-making

lessons.title: Plants make their own food
lessons.objective: Explain that a plant makes its own food rather than taking food in from the soil.
must_establish: plants make food; they do not absorb ready-made food

lessons.title: What comes out
lessons.objective: Distinguish what a plant takes in from what it gives out when it makes food.
must_establish: carbon dioxide goes in, oxygen comes out

lessons.title: Why photosynthesis matters
lessons.objective: Explain why photosynthesis matters for plants and for other living things.
must_establish: plants are the source of food for other living things
plants are a source of the oxygen animals use
